text: Semi-skimmed milk, with its fat set to 1.5 %, goes through the same ultra-high heat as whole UHT milk and is filled into sterile cartons, so it keeps for months without cooling.

steps.note: The milk is first warmed to about 75 °C in an indirect plant, or about 80 °C in a direct one.
The milk is run through continuously, and in an indirect plant it is held for about 4 s at about 138 °C, while in a direct one it is steam-injected to 140–150 °C and flash-cooled in vacuum.

steps.name: fill
steps.note: The milk is filled aseptically into sterilised cartons.
